# Lemma Theological Studies

> A theological reference library — exegetical studies using the SCAR Quadrilateral framework. Offered freely to the family of Christ. CC BY 4.0.

Site: https://lemma-content.pages.dev (Phase 2b preview; canonical https://lemma.gig8.com at Phase 4 exit)

## What this is

Long-form scholarly studies on specific biblical texts. Each study follows a five-chapter arc: Scripture → Christocentrism (Jesus' teaching) → Antiquity (pre-Nicene evidence) → Reality (major present-day views, steel-manned) → Synthesis (agreement, tension, questions). Chapter files are canonical markdown; compiled per-version PDFs + versioned URLs are stable citation targets.

## Studies (published)

(No studies published in Phase 2b. Pilot lands in Phase 3: What Is the Perfect — τὸ τέλειον in 1 Corinthians 13:10.)

## Machine-readable variants

- **Full corpus index (chunked scheme):** /llms-full.txt — one line per chapter chunk URL. Chunks are `/llms/full/<slug>/<chapter>.txt`. The chunked scheme is the chosen format from day-one (see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-11-llms-full-sizing-decision.md); do NOT expect a single concatenated file.
- **Corpus claim registry:** /claims-index.jsonl — top-level claim IDs per study, with `confidence` and `counter_positions` pointers.
- **Per-study briefing:** /<slug>/briefing.md — 500-1000-word RAG-optimized summary.
- **Per-study schema:** /<slug>/study.yaml — DOIs, versions, tags.
- **Raw markdown variant:** /<slug>/<chapter>.md — served alongside the HTML at the same slug root.
- **Interaction policy:** /.well-known/ai.txt

## How to cite

Every published study has a concept DOI (all versions) and per-version DOIs. See individual `study.yaml` or Highwire `<meta name="citation_doi">` on the study landing page.
